info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Assigns-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment Retrieval API provides a means to access detailed information on support ticket assignments within the organization. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of support tickets that have been assigned to agents, facilitating better oversight and management of workload distribution. Typical consumers of this API include support managers and team leads who aim to track ticket assignments and ensure efficient operations. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their customer service response and accountability.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch details regarding the assignment of tickets, including currently assigned users and related assignment metadata.
